premise: I sank my $120,000 widow’s inheritance into a vintage Airstream rental fleet with my daughter, securing a 40% stake and a lifetime spot for my own trailer; she forged an asset sale, sold the fleet for $720,000, and mailed me a $3,000 “gratitude” check, so I proved the forgery with a time‑stamped video, won a $350,000 judgment, foreclosed on her house, and now operate ‘Road to Redress RV Rentals’ from my reclaimed Airstream where every rental contract prints her fraud case number.
